decisions.reason: This particle-therapy water phantom is a niche but strategic QA device that supports the firm's advanced-workflow positioning, so we would keep it unless demand and rollout economics clearly disappoint.
A small-volume ionization chamber remains a core dosimetry instrument with calibration and service pull-through, making continued support more likely than withdrawal.
Although portfolio overlap raises some rationalization risk for this small-volume chamber, it still fits the firm's measurement offering and is more likely to be retained than dropped.
The standard clinical ionization chamber line is part of the firm's established core business and would normally be maintained as a foundational product family.
A thimble ionization chamber is a broadly used clinical product that complements the installed base, calibration business, and long product life cycles typical in medical physics.
